description: IBGE publishes the results of Brazil's 2022 Population Census for every census tract, the smallest area of the enumeration, as open files on its download server. The tract aggregates hold counts of persons and permanent private households by theme: basic totals, demography, literacy, colour or race, and three household characteristics files that report how each occupied dwelling gets water (general distribution network, well, other forms), whether it has a bathroom and how sewage is disposed of, and what happens to its waste (collected, skip container, burned, dumped). Further files cover the income of the household head and indigenous and quilombola households. The same variables are aggregated to neighbourhoods, districts, subdistricts and municipalities, and a companion set of tract boundaries carries the attributes as GeoPackage, shapefile and CSV. Coverage: all of Brazil. Format and access: national zipped CSV and XLSX files (the largest about 136 MB) and a data dictionary updated on 20 May 2026, free without registration on ftp.ibge.gov.br. Licence: not stated in the directory; IBGE's own web pages returned a bot challenge from the cloud, so the terms could not be read. Caveats: values are counts per tract with suppression rules described in the dictionary; small tracts may show zeros; the IBGE website itself blocks automated access. Simulation uses: population and dwelling exposure at tract level, water, sanitation and waste service gaps for utility planning, and social vulnerability layers. Related records: the IBGE block-face survey of urban surroundings from the same census, IPUMS International and the GHSL built-up and population grids.
